json-ld.description: Rustle up this tasty salmon dish with just four ingredients. Ideal for a quick and easy midweek meal with a tasty feta and beetroot salsa on the side
json-ld.name: Salmon with beetroot, feta & lime salsa
json-ld.headline: Salmon with beetroot, feta & lime salsa
json-ld.keywords: 5-a-day, Beetroot, Esther Clark, Feta, Folate, Gluten free, Lime, Omega 3, Salmon, Salsa, Summer
json-ld.recipeCategory: Dinner, Fish Course, Lunch, Main course

recipeInstructions.text: Chop the beetroot and feta into small cubes and mix with the juice and zest of one lime and some seasoning.

Season the salmon. Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a nonstick frying pan over a high heat. When hot add the salmon, skin-side down, and cook for 3 mins. Flip over, turn the heat down and cook for a further 4-5 mins. Serve with the beetroot salsa and the remaining lime, cut into wedges.
